dedupe_keys.name: ukraine 10 m crop type map 2020 and eastern ukraine war agricultural loss data

description: This deposit supports a study quantifying agricultural production losses in eastern Ukraine due to the Russia-Ukraine war, and holds a reusable 10 m crop type map of Ukraine for 2020. The Zenodo record says it also contains validation samples for crop type and planting condition, panel and economic loss tables, and Python and Google Earth Engine code for sample-based area estimation, economic loss, NDVI difference and regression analysis. It was published on 25 April 2024 by Ying Tu as a GeoTIFF of about 614 MB with small tables, sample CSV and code files, downloadable and free under CC BY 4.0, with national coverage for the crop map and eastern Ukraine for the loss analysis. Caveats: the crop map is for one year before the full-scale invasion, and loss estimates depend on the paper's sampling and price assumptions. For simulation it gives a baseline crop layer to measure how conflict, damaged infrastructure and abandoned fields reduce output, and a worked loss method for conflict and hazard scenarios. Related catalogue records include the JRC EUCROPMAP and the probabilistic crop type maps for the EU.
name: Ukraine 10 m crop type map 2020 and eastern Ukraine war agricultural loss data
